queries.prompt: Run a comprehensive OpenTelemetry security posture audit across `otel-demo` covering collectors, instrumentation CRs, eBPF pods, and RBAC roles, and produce a Markdown compliance report.
queries.notes: Full OTel security posture audit on OTEL-APP

queries.prompt: Scan our collectors in `otel-demo` for hardcoded plaintext bearer tokens, `insecure_skip_verify: true`, and wildcard Kubernetes RBAC permissions.
Harden the eBPF `obi` DaemonSet tracing `shipping` and `currency` in `otel-demo` so it drops `privileged: true` and uses least-privilege `BPF` and `PERFMON` capabilities.
Prepare our `otel-demo` OpenTelemetry telemetry pipeline (`checkout`, `payment`, `email`) for an upcoming SOC 2 and PCI-DSS security compliance audit.
Kubernetes Pod Security Admission `restricted` in `otel-demo` blocked our collector pod from starting because it ran as root without a `seccompProfile`—harden its `securityContext`.
Check whether any collector in `otel-demo` exposes unauthenticated `pprof` (`:1777`) or `zpages` (`:55679`) diagnostic endpoints on `0.0.0.0`.
Remediate hardcoded exporter API keys on `otel-insecure-collector` in `otel-demo` using Kubernetes `Secret` `secretKeyRef` and `${env:...}` variable expansion.

Review the `ClusterRole` attached to our collector ServiceAccount in `otel-demo` and our `filelog` DaemonSet host mounts to ensure `secrets` access, write verbs, and writable `/var/log` mounts are absent.
Render and audit the Helm chart security posture of `charts/image-provider` and `charts/postgresql` in `otel-demo` before installing those Helm releases.
Audit Traefik v3 `IngressRoute` and `TLSOptions` CRs fronting `frontend-proxy` in `otel-demo` for TLS 1.0/1.1 cipher weaknesses and insecure dashboard flags.
Drop healthy `200 OK` `flagd` `/healthz` spans and normalize numeric product IDs in `frontend` `url.path` using OTTL to cut metric series cardinality.
queries.notes: Cardinality & noise reduction without security audit

queries.prompt: Audit Alertmanager silence hygiene, catch-all route leaks, and HA peer gossip mesh health in `observability` for `otel-demo` alerts.
